notes: 1300 dates irrigation extent only. Climate and runoff are 1970–2000 proxies, not a reconstructed 1300 climate.
All maps use the same land-surface hectare denominator. Area enters only the shared water budget, never food or population.
Upper scenario is a constrained surface-irrigation screening, not a proven medieval maximum. Qanats, wells, reservoir storage, engineered routes and natural inundation require additional evidence.
Technology parameters are globally shared screening assumptions informed by traditional low lifts and earthen-system efficiency, not universal historical limits.
The cached HYDE April 2025 reconstruction is a model reconstruction, not an archaeological survey. Historical demand has priority when extending infrastructure.
Soil storage uses an analytical annual fixed point; there is no arbitrary transient initial stock.

historical_connections.interpretation: Low delta land historically receives Nile distributary/canal water despite independent coastal drainage polygons. This changes withdrawal origin, not available water or irrigation extent. The elevation screen is approximate.
